Storefront and customer routes of the store module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## GET /v1/store/config

The runtime store config: identity, brand, localization, money, domains

Responses:

- `200`: Store config retrieved.
